name: PT Pelita Teknologi Global Tbk
summary: Based in Indonesia, PT Pelita Teknologi Global Tbk operates as a specialist in connectivity technology. The company offers a diverse portfolio of services, including the production of smart and scratch cards. Additionally, it delivers end-to-end hardware and software solutions, encompassing implementation, bespoke customization, ongoing maintenance, and robust IT security measures. Its offerings also extend to supply chain management. Established in 2017, the firm's headquarters are located in Tangerang, Indonesia, and it functions as a subsidiary of PT Karya Permata Berkat Jaya.
